question: What act of transmission is claimed to have been completed for the listener when the practice concerning the soul is declared?
premises: This practice concerning the soul is the subject.
It has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: This practice concerning the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Full content of the practice not repeated here
plain_english: This practice concerning the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
